scope: Desktop object inspector atomic object handoff
cause: Object transitions cleared the panel, then mounted history or attachment readers only after the editor finished, causing serial requests and multiple visible intermediate states.
changes: Prefetch only the selected tab metadata in parallel with the incoming editor read.
Commit the object identity, name, metadata list and active counter together once both reads are ready.
Retain the prior object's correctly labelled metadata as inert while waiting, preserving the panel and scroll container; reset scroll only when the next complete view is committed.
Immediately close attachment previews, expanded history bodies and pending password verification on handoff; invalidate their requests and clear decrypted snapshot caches.
Discard the retained view when showing an object or metadata failure; immediately clear it on account change or lock/unlock and reject late responses from skipped objects or expired sessions.
Use a fixed-size header status slot after 250ms rather than replacing a populated list with a loading message; same-object reselect remains a no-op.

validation.baseline_negative_control: The three object handoff regression cases fail against the preceding implementation.
validation.eslint: 0 errors; one pre-existing unused event parameter warning in syncStore

production_browser.handoff_races: 16 scenarios across history/attachments and editor-first/metadata-first completion orders
frame_checks: Both IPC reads start before either controlled gate is released.
Every sampled animation frame has metadata rows, a matching object identity and name, and no full-list loading replacement.
Panel and scroll container nodes remain connected, and each target tab list is requested once per object handoff.
Revealed history fields disappear immediately during handoff.

validation.native_acceptance: Not performed for this change; platform variants use the production browser fixture.
